# Ajeem Suban

> AI & Data Science Developer and founder/creator of TAMIL-AI, a Tamil-first
> NLP/RAG platform. Builds AI/ML systems: retrieval-augmented generation
> pipelines, translation systems, and OCR tools for Indic languages.

## Identity

- Name: Ajeem Suban
- Role: AI & Data Science Developer
- Flagship project: TAMIL-AI (founder/creator)
- Education: 3rd-year B.Tech, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science,
  Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan University (2024–2028)

## Projects

- TAMIL-AI — Tamil-first NLP/RAG platform. FastAPI + ChromaDB + IndicTrans2,
  with a KalVettu OCR sub-module for Chola-era stone inscriptions. Flagship
  project.
- TITAN — personal AI workspace / system control hub, React + TypeScript,
  powered by SECRAIN as its intelligence layer.
- VCH-AGENT (Viral Content Hunter) — predictive AI system forecasting early
  viral-content signals on Reddit/YouTube.
- SECRAIN — local-first AI "second brain": FastAPI + ChromaDB + Ollama.
- AIRES — AI emergency-dispatch/routing prototype.
- Eye-Care-Tool — context-aware 20-20-20 desktop daemon (OpenCV/MediaPipe).
- news-bot — automated Telegram news digest (RSS + Gemini + GitHub Actions).
- TimeTamil — rule-based historical Tamil reconstruction engine (research
  stage).
